license: CC BY 4.0 dataset; native papers retain their own terms; no corpus redistribution in repository
selection_rule: one eligible native question per paper chosen by seeded SHA256, then first120 papers by separate seeded SHA256; no runtime-output-based exclusions or replacements
eligibility: at least one native answerable annotation with nonempty entirely textual evidence, no FLOAT SELECTED evidence, and every paragraph canonically locatable in that paper full text; retain alternative native annotations as alternatives
retrieval_scope: all 416 papers; no oracle document filters; original native question with original paper title metadata appended
retrieval_corpus_fields: title, abstract, full supplied sections, textual captions; no QA or answer fields
quality_metric: complete coverage of all native textual evidence paragraphs for at least one valid annotator alternative, actual indexed source provenance checked; strict sufficiency lower bound, equivalent sources reviewed separately if necessary
quality_uncertainty: Report Wilson95 interval for sampled distinct papers; no universal/all-language guarantee; not official generated-answer F1
latency_metric: actual MCP search_docs wall time; all first outputs kept; startup separately; median,p95,max,under10,error and joint support/time counts

configuration.build_profile: same explicit English GPU quickstart factory policy: balanced, ANN, token-aware sections1000/100, facets-v3,section-gaps-v3,query_language=en,rerank_batch8,rerank_candidates100
